const photoCreditsSection=document.createElement("section");photoCreditsSection.className="section bmw-credits-section";photoCreditsSection.id="bmw-photo-credits";photoCreditsSection.innerHTML='

12. Photograph credits

Photographs are credited to their creators under the Creative Commons licences linked for each image. Images are displayed at reduced size. Follow the source links for full licence and photograph details.

    '+Object.entries(licensedBMWPhotos).map(([model,p])=>{const url="https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:"+encodeURIComponent(p.file).replace(/%20/g,"_");return '
  • BMW '+esc(model)+' — '+esc(p.credit)+' · Original photograph ↗ · '+esc(p.license)+' ↗
    • '}).join("")+'
';document.getElementById("modelFamilies").appendChild(photoCreditsSection);

const creditSection=document.createElement("section");creditSection.className="section bmw-credits-section";creditSection.id="harley-photo-credits";creditSection.innerHTML='

Photographs are credited to their creators, or identified as images supplied to AnyBike. Some supplied photographs have edited backgrounds. Source and licence details are shown where applicable.

    '+credits.map(p=>'
  • Harley-Davidson '+escHarley(p.name)+' — '+escHarley(p.author)+(p.license&&(p.license.includes('Illustration')||p.license.includes('Branded artwork'))?' · Branded or illustrative artwork, not a verified motorcycle photograph':' · Original photograph ↗ · '+escHarley(p.license)+' ↗')+'
    • ').join("")+'
';document.getElementById("harley-credits-mount").appendChild(creditSection)}
